node.title: XR low-core near-K oriented-difference packing
node.statement: For a low-core family and an oriented indicator difference of width t=K-c, distinct residuals intersect in at most c-1 and therefore own disjoint c-subsets. Hence one fiber has size at most floor(C(N-2K+2c,c)/C(H+c-1,c)), and any set of such widths contributes at most the maximum fiber bound times |F|(|F|-1) to difference energy. The exact 8n threshold pays codimension prefixes 2,1,1,6,5,4 on the six clean-rate rows. This is an aggregate near-K energy payment; it does not count difference types, prove the P-B slope bound, or imply CAP25's local locator-SPI estimate.
